0.0.n: This morning greeting can stand alone casually; adding ございます makes it polite.

0.1.n: This is the connecting form of ござる; together with ます, it makes おはよう polite.

0.2.n: Attached to ござい, this completes the polite morning greeting.

1.0.n: This morning greeting can stand alone casually; adding ございます makes it polite.

1.1.n: This is the connecting form of ござる; together with ます, it makes おはよう polite.

1.2.n: Attached to ござい, this completes the polite morning greeting.

2.0.n: This daytime greeting ends with は, pronounced like わ.

3.0.n: This daytime greeting ends with は, pronounced like わ.

4.0.n: This evening greeting ends with は, pronounced like わ.

5.0.n: This evening greeting ends with は, pronounced like わ.

0.lit: Good morning + formal component + polite ending.
0.tip: Learn ございます as one unit that makes おはよう polite.

1.lit: Good morning + formal component + polite ending.
1.tip: Learn ございます as one unit that makes おはよう polite.

2.tip: Originally an unfinished phrase about today, こんにちは now works as a complete daytime greeting.

3.tip: Originally an unfinished phrase about today, こんにちは now works as a complete daytime greeting.

4.tip: Use こんばんは when meeting someone in the evening, not when saying goodnight.

5.tip: Use こんばんは when meeting someone in the evening, not when saying goodnight.
